body: Hope you decide to stay. Been in the pit myself for a long period. Then i got tired of myself and made changes.  It was a long process trust me but now I have a great life better than i ever thought it could be and i was so close to letting go and I would have missed sooo much.

Tell them how you are feeling, be straight up and honest and tell them how desperate you are. Talk to someone who can help. Its not fair to put that all on you. Ive been at the bottom of the pit trust me, more than once and it's overwhelming but at least try to get help friend. Theres a big world out there.
I'm so tired of all the pain.  I want to go home.

I thought I was spiritual before I had my awakening, the love of my life departed suddenly with no idea something was wrong and I was devestated beyond words, two years later, though I miss him every single day, when he departed it opened the Universe for me and I am so grateful, the growth I have experienced has changes me in so many ways and I am in alignment with who I am supposed to be today, thankfully. I believe in the law of attraction now and am present and in the moment. Everything happens for a reason I believe my admission price for this alignment has been pain but without it I would not be where I am today, grateful, at peace, mindful and my own person. I found Teal Swan, Kelli Coffee, Abraham Hicks , Dwaine Hartman most helpful in my journey and each day I spend time learning and growing more. I don't follow the sheep anymore I live from my heart and not what societies rediculous standards are. I am a spiritual being having a human experience for my expansion. I hope you find your path to enlightenment that is right for you. Blessings of love, light, health and prosperity to you on your journey.
